main:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 8-frame 2D WALK-CYCLE sprite atlas for a mobile prison puzzle game. Input image is the EXACT merchant identity and art-style reference. Create new independent walking poses of THIS merchant, not translated/warped/scaled copies of his standing sprite.

OUTPUT: one RGBA transparent-background sprite sheet, exactly FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, total EIGHT full-body sprites, no border, no text, no numbers, no grid lines, no props/background, no baked shadows. Prefer 2048×1024 canvas, eight equal 512×512 cells. Order frame0,1,2,3 in top row then frame4,5,6,7 in bottom row. All figures face screen RIGHT in the exact slightly top-down THREE-QUARTER camera angle of the reference, never left or back; a consistent light from upper-left. Each whole body should be comfortably inside its cell with transparent gutters; feet stay near the same horizontal baseline and head-center axis. Each figure about 425px tall in a 512px cell, head size uniform, no cut-off hands/hat/shoes. Keep pose-to-pose full-body height and head width within 3%. A small natural gait bob is okay.

IDENTITY STRICTLY PRESERVED: friendly stout middle-aged clean-shaven man, round face and large cartoon nose, short gray side hair, brown flat cap, ivory short-sleeved collared shirt, dark teal-green apron/tunic with one chest pocket, dark brown waist belt with gold rectangular buckle, a small ochre leather pouch at his left hip, brown trousers and charcoal chunky shoes. Same face, clothing, proportions, palette and thick deep-ink outline as input image. No moustache, beard, tool, backpack, blue police uniform, new jewelry or orange prisoner suit. Retain warm subtle hand-painted texture and simple shading, not pixel art, not 3D plastic. No cast/contact shadow under any frame.

TRUE 8-POSE LOOP: an ordinary purposeful relaxed WALK, not running, not bouncing idle, not marching both feet together. Anatomically clear two legs plus alternating arm swing. First half is leg A stepping forward, second half leg B stepping forward; top and bottom rows MUST NOT duplicate the same step. Near and far legs retain distinguishable occlusion/shading.
frame0 = A contact: near leg extended forward to RIGHT with heel touching, far leg extended behind to LEFT, near arm swings back and far arm forward.
frame1 = A down/recoil: weight transfers onto forward near leg, knees slightly compress, rear far heel lifts.
frame2 = A passing: supporting near foot below torso, far bent knee passes under/forward; arms close to body crossing neutral.
frame3 = A up: near supporting leg pushes back/raises heel, far knee leads forward in RIGHT direction, arm swing approaches opposite maximum.
frame4 = B contact: FAR leg now extends forward RIGHT, NEAR leg extends behind LEFT, near arm swings forward and far arm back; visibly opposite limb order to frame0.
frame5 = B down/recoil: forward far foot takes weight, rear near heel lifts, opposite arm/leg occlusion to frame1.
frame6 = B passing: far supporting foot below torso, near bent leg passes forward, opposite limb order to frame2.
frame7 = B up: far supporting heel lifts, near knee reaches forward ready to return to frame0; arms return smoothly toward initial swing.
Exactly eight genuine redraws with clear different shoe spacing, knee bends and hand locations. Walking should loop smoothly at 12fps, duration 2/3 second. Preserve merchant face/cap/head axis and belt buckle shape across poses. Empty transparent margins between cells must remain clean; DO NOT render a checkerboard or white background as pixels. Real alpha transparency.
correction:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production 4×2 eight-frame right-facing WALK-CYCLE sprite sheet. Input image is the EDIT TARGET. Keep exactly this merchant identity, round clean-shaven face, brown flat cap, gray side hair, ivory shirt, teal apron, brown trousers, gold buckle, ochre hip pouch, charcoal shoes, hand-painted rendering, grid FOUR columns by TWO rows, full-body scale and transparent background. Do not change character facing or camera angle.
Change ONLY the B-step gait articulation of the BOTTOM ROW frames4–7. Preserve top row frames0–3 as first-step contact/down/passing/up. Bottom row currently repeats the same visible leg kick and same arm direction as top row. It must switch LEADING LEG and opposite ARM swing. Do NOT merely repeat or mirror the top row poses or flip the sprite.

Bottom frame4 CONTACT B: NEAR leg which led in top frame0 is now BEHIND, extended to screen LEFT; FAR leg comes from far/right hip and extends FORWARD screen RIGHT, heel on common floor line. The NEAR arm must reach FORWARD toward screen RIGHT ACROSS the front of the chest, fist ahead of chest. FAR arm extends BACK, partly obscured. Distinct overlapping legs and arm silhouettes from top frame0.
Bottom frame5 DOWN B: weight on FAR forward leg with knee bending. NEAR trailing leg lifts behind and knee folds. NEAR arm retracts from forward apex across chest, FAR arm passes back. Narrower stance than frame4. Do NOT match top frame1.
Bottom frame6 PASS B: FAR leg supports under hip. NEAR thigh/knee swings THROUGH IN FRONT of the supporting far leg, clearly visible raised shoe/knee crossing the planted leg. NEAR hand slightly ahead of hip and FAR hand behind, opposite overlap to top frame2.
Bottom frame7 UP B: FAR supporting foot pushes on toe; NEAR knee and shoe move forward/up toward screen RIGHT ready for top frame0 contact. NEAR arm moves BACK and FAR arm comes FORWARD. Smooth closure to first row.
Registration: heads/caps all the SAME SIZE, torso centers stay in each cell. Full-body height must match top row within 2%. Grounded foot soles contact about90% cell-height line. Head bob <=2%. Full sprites within transparent gutters, no clipping. Exactly two arms/two legs, no duplicate limbs, no blur, no motion ghosts, no symbols/numbers/text/lines and NO baked shadows. Real transparent RGBA. Eight independently drawn poses, two alternating leg steps.
